text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The Queen Elizabeth II Cup has come to
a close!
This year's queen has been
decided!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...It's over.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, please give a big round of
applause for
our new queen!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The Queen Elizabeth II Cup was the
stage I always
dreamed of...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
But I wasn't able to win, and now it's
over.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I tried. I really gave it all I had.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
But it wasn't enough... I finally reached
the race I
always dreamed of, and I just...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Right. You're... right!
choice_data_list: 戦い続ければ必ず勝てる

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A princess never gives up. I won't stop
until I
become my ideal self.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Next time I race here, I'll claim the
victory I
dreamed of!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At Kawakami Princess's request, we look
out over
the track from the stands until
it's time for the
concert.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It was only a short time ago I was
running along
this track...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What're you spacing out for?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Sweep?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
First, I'll say this—I'm entering both the
Victoria
Mile and the Queen Elizabeth II
Cup next year.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You should enter too, if you want. Even
after our
classic year is over, we can still
compete in our
senior year.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...I know.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I want to decide my next
objective.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
So that I can enter this race again... So
that I can
become a princess.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Once winter is over, Kawakami Princess's
senior
year will begin. To support her
development, I
should set her an
objective prior to the G1 spring
season.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A medium-distance G2 race on turf. It
takes place
in March, so she should be
able to handle it no
matter which G1
race she wants to enter during
the spring
season.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Right. Roger that! Let's put together a
training
regimen once we get back to
the academy.

text_block_list.name: Lady in a Dress
text_block_list.text: Murmur...

text_block_list.name: Lady with Hat
text_block_list.text: Murmur...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess suddenly stops in her
tracks.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Um. Oh, it's nothing...

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Here you are! I have something to
discuss
regarding the concert rehearsal...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the end, between the rehearsal and
then the
concert afterwards, I never find
a chance to ask
her about what made
her stop so suddenly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even after returning to my office,
Kawakami
Princess is still...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
N-no, today's fine! I'd rather have it
now...
choice_data_list: ミーティングはまた明日にしようか

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It'll keep my mind from wandering to
other things.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzz... Bzzz...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's my phone. The name that appears on
the
screen is that of the TV producer we
spoke to
during the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh—you're getting a call! Go ahead and
answer
it. I'll just wait over here.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course! Go ahead! We can start
the
meeting once you're done!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rattle...

text_block_list.name: Lady in a Dress
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, it's that Kawakami Princess. Do
you
suppose she's actually friends with
Sweep Tosho?

text_block_list.name: Lady with Hat
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, that would explain quite a bit. She
was so
self-centered during the
Japanese Oaks and
Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Lady in a Dress
text_block_list.text:
Unquestionably. She doesn't act like her
name in
the slightest. I'm glad she wasn't
the one who
became queen.

text_block_list.name: Lady with Hat
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, surely fate has frowned upon her.
She's not
fit to be a queen.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'm not fit to be a queen... That's why
fate has
frowned upon me.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
No... I need to snap myself out of this
funk! A real
princess wouldn't let this
bother her! I can't... let
this...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Arrgh! Hmph! Yaaah! Hah! Hup!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: HIIIYAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thump! Rattle! Craaash! Flutter!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Uwah?! Ack, did I hit that box?! All the

documents are—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh no... I have to tidy all this up before
Trainer
gets back...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? This is...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, Trainer! ...Oh? Why do you
look so
flustered?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Come ooon, you should know that a
princess is
very perceptive! I'll have to
pretend I didn't see
anything. ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. You actually prepared a surprise
present for when
I win the Queen
Elizabeth II Cup. ♪ That's my
trainer—so
considerate. ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
This is... the surprise present Trainer was
hiding
from me before.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Glances around nervously...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Trainer... but I could really use
this
pick-me-up right now.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
When the big reveal happens, I'll just act

surprised like I never saw it before.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Letters? And they're addressed to
both Trainer
and me. There are so
many—even more than the
fan letters I
get.
